annotations.title: Nvidia Hub: live Nvidia, where the AI money goes when Nvidia is sold, earnings, options and AI spending

description: The OwlChart Nvidia Hub in one tool (v5.896): what=market (NVDA price, change against yesterday's close, day range, pre market or after hours price, the highest trade, 7 day, 30 day and 1 year moves, market value, market open or closed, the next results date), brief (the facts, a plain read, the headline, the AI crypto verdict, the open risk stories), rotation (days=90 or 30: for the chip stocks, big tech, chip and tech funds, defensive funds, T-bill funds, gold, the dollar, Bitcoin, Ether and the AI tokens CARV, FET, TAO, VIRTUAL and their basket: today's move, the average move and on how many days it went up on the days Nvidia fell 2% or more, a plain label RECEIVING, SOLD WITH NVIDIA or NEUTRAL, the 30 and 90 day correlation word, today's ranked receivers and the markets sold together), verdict (is Nvidia money reaching the AI tokens: NOT RECEIVING, STARTING or RECEIVING with a 0 to 100 gauge, each sign and the history by day), hourly (Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, SMH, the AI token basket and Bitcoin as percent from the open, hour by hour, and the hour the tokens split from Nvidia), news (Nvidia headlines with the share price move in the 60 minutes after each, and the risk strip), insiders (SEC Form 4 trades of the last 10 days), options (call and put volume, put to call ratio, 30 day implied volatility, biggest strikes, the implied move into the results; Cboe delayed quotes), supply-chain (capital spending of Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta by quarter from SEC filings, accelerating or slowing), earnings (the last 8 quarters: revenue, data center revenue, gross margin, the beat or miss against Nvidia's own guidance range, the next day move, the live guidance) or crypto (correlation of each AI token with Nvidia over 30 and 90 days and the basket priced in Nvidia shares). v5.898: carv (CARV, the AI token that follows Nvidia most closely: the 30 and 90 day link and beta, every day Nvidia moved 3% or more with CARV the same day and the next, CARV the day after each results report, and whether CARV moved the same way as Nvidia between its close and its next open), fundamentals (from Nvidia's own SEC filings and the live price: revenue, growth, gross, operating and net margin, earnings per share, cash left after investment, return on equity and assets, cash, debt, price to earnings, price to sales, enterprise value to EBITDA) or comps (the same sums for AMD, Broadcom, Qualcomm, Micron and Intel). Analyst targets are not shown: no raw source publishes them. Moving together is not proof that money moved from one market to the other. Data, not advice. Page: https://owlchart.com/nvidia.html

days.description: rotation: the window in days, default 90

what.description: which Nvidia data set, default brief
